study_meta.population_raw: Symptomatic patients with SARS-CoV-2 in Bahia Blanca city; first 18 secondary patients infected with SARS-CoV-2; 70% hospital staff
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 17 infectee-infector pairs (full sample); 13 most certain pairs (reduced sample); 15 incubation period observations (12 most certain)
study_meta.method_raw: Contact tracing / chain of infections; Gamma distribution for serial interval fitted by maximum likelihood; Lognormal for incubation period; Bayesian MCMC approach also used; bootstrapping validation

parameter_mentions.value_raw: 6.8 days (full sample, parametric); 5.5 days (most certain pairs, parametric); 6.88 days (full sample, Bayesian); 6.12 days (most certain pairs, Bayesian)
